testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer multiple selected commands between customization lists: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:620:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer multiple selected commands between customization lists ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And All Commands lists "2D Sketches" immediately before "3D Annotations" ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user presses Shift+Down ✔ Then both commands are selected in the available list ✔ When the user clicks the right transfer button ✔ Then the custom panel list contains "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations" ✔ And neither command remains in the available list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list ✔ And the user presses Shift+Down ✔ And the user clicks the left transfer button ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty ✔ And both commands return to the available list ✔ And the target still indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
